notes.title: Pre-Release Build Update + Participation
notes.content: [p]A massive update for Broke Signal Badlands has been released, adding the following changes, fixes, and additions. We are gearing up for release on Steam soon, which means that we now need a wave of players to play the game! [url="https://forwardinstinct.itch.io/broke-signal-badlands"]Head here and scroll to the bottom to participate.[/url][/p][p]We have added a massive amount of new content and features. Let's dig in:[/p][list][*][p]The game now totals [b]65+ encounters, with 22 new encounters added.[/b] The wordcount has expanded to 40,000+ words, or the length of a small book. [b][i]This represents the final, full content of the game![/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional encounter and landmark locations have been added to the map. [/b]The map should feel a bit more alive and busy than before as a result.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A few new items[/b] have been added, to be found by the player.[/p][/*][*][p]An extremely cool [b]new secret endgame weapon[/b] has been added. Can you unlock it?[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 new shootouts[/b] have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]1 unique[b] knife fight encounter[/b] has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The dialogue can now be [b]advanced by hitting Space[/b], and options can now be [b]selected by using WASD and Space[/b]! Mice haters rejoice. You still have to drag dice to roll and use the mouse to shoot/stab, however.[/p][/*][/list][p]Some changes and bugfixes have also been addressed:[/p][list][*][p][b]Encounters are rebalanced[/b] to properly balance them for all the different encounters players can face now. You may notice some are easier than before, while some are a bit harder.[/p][/*][*][p]A black background has been added to the journal screen, to make it easier to read.[/p][/*][*][p]The stats screen has been amended to make it easier to understand, and persuade players to pick an Ace skill.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial has been updated to make Dusk/Dawn dice clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]Several warning messages and text have been updated to make it clearer that you need to drag dice to roll them.[/p][/*][*][p]Some cursory spelling and phrasing updates to existing encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double-clicking the roll button when rolling causing the encounter to fail.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dice staying in the rack when dragging a dice but choosing to back out of the encounter, resulting in extra dice available for the next encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dice-roller preview dice not changing theme properly between day and night.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed aspect ratio frame not properly changing theme between day and night.[/p][/*][/list][p]A few changes remain on the horizon for Steam, and are not in the game yet. This includes:[/p][list][*][p]New Music[/p][/*][*][p]Music Playlist setup[/p][/*][*][p]Sound pass on encounters[/p][/*][*][p]Art for each ending[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Prequel Tutorial Section[/p][/*][*][p]Controls for controllers[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Options, such as precise glitching settings and image scanner speed[/p][/*][*][p]Options in Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]New demo build with the tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p]Known Issues in this build:[/p][list][*][p]Weird errors with allocating an ace in the stats screen when you empty a stat entirely, then fill it back up and ace the stat.[/p][/*][*][p]Weird issue with dice getting "eaten" when adding to a stat with no current dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Can drag dice, pointlessly, in the stats screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet count during shootouts shows bullets rolled, but does not show them vanish as they're fired.[/p][/*][*][p]Escaping the Red Hills Marina monster is not affected by if you are out of dice on the second roll - need to be addressed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Broke Signal Badlands is a pocket Fallout RPG for weird western dice-addled mystics
notes.content:
It's hotter than the inside of a horse here, so what better time to play an RPG about driving randomly through the desert in search of enlightenment. The RPG in question is Broke Signal Badlands: A World of Desert Adventure, and yes, that's a very upbeat subtitle for a game in which you can perish after getting your hand stuck in the door of an abandoned Fonts Museum, or while yanking cacti out of your foot. There are gunfights, too, with dice serving as bullets, but so far, I've only managed to die of pathetic human error and clumsiness. Consider me unenlightened, but enthused.

notes.title: Next Fest: Limited Time Full Game Access
notes.content:
It's that time of year again - Broke Signal Badlands is here for the Summer Next Fest! I've been hard at work cooking a new update for y'all, which is temporarily for free on Steam as part of Next Fest.

A very big and very cool update for Broke Signal Badlands is now available:

[u][b]Music![/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a full soundtrack, with 7 unique tracks! More will be coming as we push updates. You can hear one in the new trailer.
[/list]
[u][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/u][list]
[*] Added Journaling system: Players now have the option to reflect on their days/nights before camping. This has an interesting effect on your camping experience and the ending you get, depending on what you think about most in the journal.
[*] Added new Camping transitions, based on your Journal choices.
[*] Added 5 new endings (and Discoveries for each), based on your Journal choices. See if you can get them all![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787377/cc81a06f50d27f600407ae6a59f975257d0f3dd3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787377/f1a50b448ffc68544d93f37ced19151e37200412.png[/img]

[u][b]Map Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*] Added 4 new random encounters. Go find them!
[*] Added road, highway, and region names, for easier navigation around the map.
[*] Added map boundaries, for those persistent players that try to climb out of the mountains.
[*] Added new icons for Encounters and Landmarks! Cacti, bushes, people, and buildings now dot the landscape.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787377/3a835a2ccc54525f5ee4c4cf35d7be8b57dd08ae.png[/img]

[u][b]Minor Changes[/b][/u][list]
[*] Added a setting slider for the Music.
[*] Added social media links to the main menu and pause menu, for ease of contact.
[*] Fixed random events turning their audio off upon starting them.
[*] Fixed a bug related to players being able to infinitely pass events if they ran out of reroll dice.
[*] Fixed a few other small bugs.
[/list]
